title: cmfqsar: Continuous Molecular Fields for 3D-QSAR
description:
An implementation of the Continuous Molecular Fields (CMF) approach to 3D-QSAR: molecular fields as sums of atom-centred Gaussians, kernels as analytic overlap integrals, kernel ridge regression, support-vector and Gaussian-process learners, molecular co-fields and their decompositions, with a desktop application, a command-line tool and a library. The package also covers crystals and surfaces through periodic and invariant kernels, atoms as samples through the local kernel, and the checks around a cross-validated q².

The manual (docs/CMF_manual.pdf) documents the method and every measurement; benchmarks/run_all.py rebuilds every table in it.
